name: The Neighborhood Tavern
description: A small, family-run neighborhood bar on Merritts Road in South Farmingdale, known as TNT, with pool, darts, a jukebox and karaoke nights. Local cover bands play there on some weekend nights.

dancing.notes: This is a cozy local bar, not a dance club, so expect little open room. Band nights are pitched as parties, and a Halloween 2026 band night invited people to dance, so some freestyle dancing near the band is likely on busy nights.

evidence.note: Listing describes a small, friendly dive bar with Friday karaoke and calls it an intimate place to see a band.
Midnight Bourbon's Oct 31, 2026 Halloween show at TNT, promoted with live country rock, party hits, dancing and no cover.
The Hit List Band played TNT on Saturday, Sept 26, 2026 at 8 PM; the listing gives the 182 Merritts Rd, Suite B address.
The bar's own older website: family-owned since 1985 (first as The Grog Shop), with a jukebox, sports on TV and pool and dart teams.

factsSource: Checked October 5, 2026. Sources: neighborhoodtavern.wixsite.com, restaurantji.com, allevents.in.
reviewNotes: Added from the town-by-town source search (2026-10-05): a venue in local bands' gig lists.
